aakasam-lo-oka-tara.text: Most viewers praised the film as a heart-melting, feel-good drama, highlighting Dulquer Salmaan's magnetic performance, Satvika's impressive debut, and Shruti Haasan's fitting role. The G.V. Prakash music and BGM were described as the soul of the movie, complemented by Pavan Sadineni's direction, fast pacing, and high-quality visuals. While the overall reaction was positive, some noted the movie follows a usual template.

anbe-diana.text: Audiences have praised Anbe Diana as a wholesome family entertainer, highlighting Pari Elavazhagan's direction and his ability to make the city of Perambur feel like a character. Viewers enjoyed the romantic story and the performance of Ramya Ranganathan in her lead debut, with specific praise for a fun final 30 minutes. A heartfelt thanks card for Chief Minister Vijay at the start of the film also stood out to many.

appa-kutty.text: Most viewers praised the film as a heartwarming family entertainer, highlighting the emotional father-daughter bond and the strong performances of Vijay Antony and the child actor. The direction by Mu. Maran and the music were well-received, with particular praise for the engaging courtroom sequences and an emotional climax. Some viewers found the first half to be slow or reminiscent of a television serial, and some felt the comedy was a miss.

arjunan-per-paththu.text: Audiences are praising Yogi Babu's performance and his "mass entry" in this milestone 300th film. The music by D. Imman is also receiving positive attention, alongside the visuals of the lead actress.

athiradi.text: Audiences are praising the film as a high-energy commercial entertainer, highlighting the strong chemistry and ego clash between Tovino Thomas and Basil Joseph. The movie is noted for its seamless blend of comedy, emotional beats, and mass elevation scenes that keep the pacing engaging from start to finish.

ayogya-2.text: Audiences are highly praising the music by Arjun Janya, particularly the song "Hudgir Dangerous" performed by Vijay Prakash, and enjoy Sathish Neenasam's dance performances. The comedy pairing of Shivraj KR Pete and Girish Shivanna is also highlighted as a strong point.

bachelor-party-d-eux.text: Many viewers found the film to be all style and no substance, criticizing the weak storytelling, poor casting, and an over-reliance on slow-motion gimmicks. Others praised Amal Neerad's stylish direction, the high-quality visuals, and the background score. While some felt Naslen's performance was lacking, others enjoyed the Hansika and Naslen pairing and highlighted a decent cameo by Tovino Thomas.

bala-369.text: Audiences generally enjoyed the film's brilliant fantasy concept and rural backdrop, highlighting the high-energy comedy performances of Viva Harsha and Getup Srinu. The music and songs composed by Dr. Sandeep were praised, as was Vijay Kumar Kalivarapu's direction. Some viewers found certain plot points, such as the protagonist traveling to Pakistan, to be nonsensical.

balan-the-boy.text: Audiences and industry professionals have praised the film for its gripping mystery and strong emotional core, specifically highlighting the story of the bond between a mother and son. Farzana Palathingal's performance is described as a revelation, and Sushin Shyam's music is noted as a highlight. Director Chidambaram is credited for balancing the thriller elements with a poignant drama.

bhogi.text: Most viewers praised Sharwanand's raw, rugged performance and his transformation into the role of Ganga, alongside Sampath Nandi's direction of the mass action sequences and emotional depth. The film's visuals, BGM by Bheems, and rustic village setting were highlighted as strong points. However, some critics felt the story was lacking and questioned the authenticity of the regional representation.

brindavihari.text: Opinions are divided, with some praising the film as a unique family entertainer and others criticizing it as a boring failure with poor writing and illogical screenplay. Supporters highlight Ganesh's fantastic acting and the soulful music by Hesham Abdul Wahab, while critics blast Srinivasa Raju's direction and compare the plot to a low-budget version of The Truman Show. Some viewers found the story confusing and the comedy ineffective, while others enjoyed the action sequences.

cosmic-samson.text: Most viewers praised Cosmic Samson as a fun fantasy entertainer, highlighting Sandeep Pradeep's performance and his comedic chemistry with Mukesh, as well as the stunning visuals and a high-impact climax. Some critics, however, found the concept weak and bizarre, comparing the execution to a children's TV serial with an underwhelming villain gang. A few viewers noted issues with the pacing, describing the first half as flat.

dad-s-little-friend.text: Audiences generally praised this feel-good family entertainer for its emotional story and the heartwarming bond between the father and daughter, specifically highlighting the powerful climax and the performances of child artist Pharrnitha Rudra Raju and Rajath Raghav. The music, visuals, and direction by Sharath Kuppa Kumar were well-received, though some viewers noted a slow screenplay. One viewer mentioned that the final 30 minutes are particularly emotional.

delivery-boy.text: Many viewers are excited about the emotional family drama and the mother-son bond featured in the story, specifically praising Radhika Sarathkumar's performance and the choreography. Others found the acting over-the-top and felt there was a lack of chemistry between the leads, Leo Sivakumar and Brigida Saga.

ene-repeat.text: Most viewers praised the film as a laugh riot, highlighting Tharun Bhascker's direction and Vivek Sagar's music, while many found the climax and the final 20 minutes particularly satisfying. Performances by Vishwak Sen and Abhinav Gomatam were frequently singled out as strengths, though some felt the pacing stumbled in the first 15 minutes or that the core emotion of the first film was missing. A few viewers noted that some scenes felt lengthy or the plot was predictable at times.

gd-naidu.text: Audiences are praising the inspiring story of visionary inventor G.D. Naidu, specifically highlighting Madhavan's transformation and performance as the lead. The visuals and the chemistry between Madhavan and Dushara Vijayan in the romantic song "Manasa Parichaye" have also been noted as highlights.

graamaayana.text: Most viewers praised the raw and authentic rural setup, highlighting Vinay Rajkumar's powerful and intense performance and the soulful music of the song "Yene Helu Kusuma." The film is noted for its impressive production value and a wide range of memorable characters. Some expressed concerns regarding a lack of public buzz and publicity leading up to the release.

hail-mary.text: Viewers found the movie boring with a wack story, and some felt it was a poor adaptation compared to the book. A few others found it to be a good story or enjoyed it.

haindava.text: Most viewers praised the film's divine and adventurous story, the raw and rustic screen presence of Bellamkonda Srinivas, and the high-quality music. The visuals, particularly the filming on a glass bridge in Vizag, and the performance of J. D. Chakravarthi were also highlighted. Some critics found the plot repetitive or boring, while others noted the movie was postponed to improve technical standards.

high.text: Most viewers are praising the high-energy music by Vikas Badisa and the spirited performances by the LMA children, while others liked the "new age" filmmaking and direction by S. Krishna. Some viewers highlighted a strong second half and praised the acting of Sai Krishna. Conversely, some found the content confusing or disliked the use of anime-style elements.

idhayam-murali.text: Most viewers found the movie to be a feel-good romantic entertainer, praising the visuals, Thaman's music, and the performances of Atharvaa, Preity Mukhundhan, and Kayadu Lohar. Some viewers criticized the pacing as too long, noting a weak screenplay and a disappointing climax. Fahadh Faasil's appearance and Kayadu Lohar's dance sequences stood out as highlights.

itllu-arjuna.text: Audiences mostly praised the film as a decent entertainer, highlighting Aniesh's strong debut performance, the chemistry between Aniesh and Anaswara Rajan, and an impressive climax. Thaman's background score and songs were major highlights, while Mahesh Uppala's direction and the story were also well-received. Some viewers criticized the lead actor's appearance, comparing him to other actors, and questioned the movie's longevity in theaters.

jana-nayagan.text: Audiences are praising Vijay's performance, specifically highlighting his emotional scenes, dialogue delivery, dance, and singing, while also appreciating H. Vinoth's direction and the BGM. The film is noted for its social awareness, featuring themes related to Ambedkar, Marx, and Periyar. Some viewers mentioned that the movie's potential was affected by HD leaks prior to release.

jayannth-the-jingo-pen.text: Many viewers felt the film was a mere remake of the Malayalam movie Philips & The Monkey Pen and criticized it for attempting to brainwash children. On the other hand, some praised the acting of Sai Krishna and described the story as a heartwarming experience for families. There were also mentions of specific discussions involving Tanikella Bharani and Satyam Rajesh.

jedusi.text: Many viewers appreciated Jedusi as a gripping social thriller, praising its focus on crimes against women and the energy brought by new faces, specifically noting Suvetha's bold role and Black Pandi's performance. The film's music and direction were highlighted as positive elements, though some critics found the revenge plot familiar and the trailer's execution poor.

john-doe.text: Many viewers found the film dull with an uninterestingly written screenplay, noting that the pacing felt stretched and the climax was underwhelming. Some criticized Arjun Das's voice as distracting and felt he was a misfit for the role, while others found the music and direction average. Conversely, some praised Arjun Das's performance as a complex character and appreciated the first-half screenplay, investigation scenes, and overall suspense.

karavali.text: Audiences have reacted positively to the emotional storytelling and the depiction of the cultural Kambala race, with particular praise for Mithra's standout performance. The music and high-energy tracks were also highlighted as strengths. However, some viewers noted concerns regarding the dubbing of Prajwal Devaraj's voice and a perceived lack of physical preparation for his role.

karuppu.text: Audiences are praising Karuppu as a masterfully made commercial entertainer, highlighting Suriya's powerful performance and aura, as well as the music and BGM by Sai Abhyankkar. Viewers specifically enjoyed the emotional depth, the high-energy "GodMode" sequences, and the interval block. The film is noted for its appeal to family audiences and its overall engaging quality.

lakshmikanthan-kolai-vazhakku.text: Audiences liked the intense story based on a true 1972 murder case, praising its exploration of the death penalty debate and the powerful performance by Vetri. The soulful music by Darbuka Siva, particularly the song Kaadhal Seiveer inspired by Bharathiyar's poetry, and Dayal Padmanabhan's direction were also highlighted.

lakshmiputhra.text: Audiences largely praised Chikkanna's natural charm and energy as a lead, along with the emotional mother-son sentiment and the music by Arjun Janya. Some viewers found the story dated and questioned the decision to cast a comedian as the lead actor. The "Amma song" and the emotional climax specifically stood out to many.

lambodhara-2-0.text: Audiences largely praised Simple Suni's direction and the film's original blend of science fiction, tradition, and spiritual themes, specifically highlighting the futuristic gadgets, the robotic character JIA, and the unique "happiness competition" plot. The music, particularly the "Happy Happy" song, was well-received, and viewers enjoyed the cameo by Meghana Gaonkar. However, some viewers found the movie wasteful or too similar to the film *Lik*, with one critic noting they did not like the lead actor's appearance.

love-seasons.text: Audiences appreciated Kruthvik's direction of this heartfelt, feel-good story, praising it as a fresh and relatable take on love. The music and BGM were highlighted as significant strengths of the film.

maarige-daari.text: Many viewers praised the film's visuals, sound design, and the "next level" background music, while also appreciating Agastya's performance and direction. However, other viewers criticized the movie as a derivative copy of films like KGF, Salaar, and Animal, calling the dialogues cringe and the screenplay lacking. Some specifically noted that while the technical presentation is strong, the execution feels like a repetitive focus on violence and build-up.

maya-lady.text: Most viewers praised the natural chemistry and performances of Rakesh Varre and Madhumita Sarkar, with particular appreciation for Sarkar's ability to play two contrasting characters. The film is noted for its blend of romance and comedy, featuring surprising twists and a highlight performance by comedian Satya in the pub episode. However, some critics found the story unoriginal and felt the trailer revealed too much of the plot.

melcow-pondicherry.text: The majority of viewers found the film to be a failure, criticizing the thin story, the climax, and Arjun Ashokan's acting, while some felt the horror elements were poorly executed. Conversely, some viewers enjoyed it as a lighthearted family entertainer, specifically praising the songs and the performances of Balu Varghese and Althaf Salim. A few viewers noted that the film feels outdated in its comedy style.

minnum-oar-iravu.text: Early reactions are largely positive, with praise for Inigo's screen presence as a lead and the gripping, suspenseful script directed by Sivaprabhu Selvaraj. The music and background score are highlighted as standout elements, alongside high-quality visuals and trailer shots. A few viewers noted a spelling mistake in the title and one person expressed dislike for the violin in the score.

mouna-mozhigal.text: Audiences generally praised the film's music and songs, describing the soundtrack as addictive and heartfelt. Viewers appreciated the emotional climax and the performances of Shakir Mano, Archana, and veterans Thalaivasal Vijay and Meera, noting that the story is a crisp, real-life inspired rom-com with a strong message. Some critics gave the film a lower rating, while one viewer expressed boredom with the use of AI in the visuals.

mysaa.text: The majority of reactions are positive, with many praising Rashmika Mandanna's fierce transformation into a mass action avatar and her screen presence. The remix of the song "Osey Ramulamma" is a major highlight, with viewers complimenting the music, lyrics, and visuals. Some critics, however, have questioned Rashmika's ability to perform action scenes and suggested the plot may be similar to Tomb Raider.

nee-nange-allava.text: Many viewers enjoyed the movie for its story, the music, and the action performances of Rahul Arcot, with some highlighting its strong social message regarding women's safety. Conversely, some critics found the plot predictable, the pacing of the first half too slow, and the background music ineffective. The film's blend of a one-sided love story shifting into action was specifically noted.

niram.text: Audience reaction is divided, with some praising the intriguing psychological investigation and the narration, while others found parts of it cringey. Some viewers appreciated the performances of Nitin Sathyaa and the music, though others felt the pacing dragged in the second half and the climax was undercooked. A few viewers specifically highlighted the cute chemistry between characters.

nooru-saami.text: Audiences and filmmakers have praised the emotional story, which is based on real-life events and focuses on the human side of a mother's love. Director Sasi is commended for his honest direction, while the performances of Vijay Antony and Swasika, along with the music and cinematography, are highlighted as strong points. One viewer noted that the film glorifies motherly affection by portraying the mother as a deity.

o-m-operation-mole.text: Most viewers praised the powerhouse performances of Dhanush, Mammootty, and Sai Pallavi, alongside an engaging story and energetic music by Sai Abhyankkar, particularly the Veezha Veera sequence. Some criticized the film as being derivative or lacking emotional connection, with a few finding the first half lengthy or the background score patchy. The interval twist and a forest scene in the second half were highlighted as standout moments.

parasakthi.text: Most viewers found the film frustrating, criticizing the story for prioritizing a loud political narrative over a more compelling human tragedy and noting production delays due to censorship issues. Some also pointed to a lack of chemistry between Sivakarthikeyan and Sreeleela. Conversely, some enjoyed the music and Sivakarthikeyan's mass entry and title card.

parimala-and-co.text: Audiences are praising Parimala And Co as a charming dark comedy and family entertainer, highlighting Pandiraj's direction and a gripping mystery story that unfolds with a satisfying climax. The performances by Jayaram and Urvashi are frequently lauded as a joy to watch, alongside a standout character portrayal by Mysskin. Viewers particularly enjoyed the well-timed situational humor and the film's balance of emotions and suspense.

pei-pidichirukku.text: Most viewers praised the film's engaging story, unexpected ending, and the performance of Ajith. The music, particularly the love song, and the steady pacing were also highlighted as strengths. Some viewers felt the movie was a waste of money.

prempaatta.text: Most viewers praised the film as a refreshing, feel-good campus entertainer, highlighting Joemon Jyothir's organic acting and strong performances from Saiju Kurup and Anusree. The music and background score, particularly the song "Nenchaadiye," were widely appreciated, alongside the vibrant setting of an NSS camp. However, some critics found the storyline predictable and the writing cringe-worthy, noting poor pacing in certain sequences and criticizing specific plot points regarding religious themes.

relax.text: Many viewers are excited for the film, praising the songs and describing the trailer as fun and promising for a family entertainer, with specific appreciation for Komal's look. However, some critics feel the story is outdated and that the trailer reveals too much of the plot. A few users also noted that while the movie looks good, the trailer's editing is poor.

sathyavan-savithiri.text: Most viewers praised the gripping courtroom drama, specifically highlighting Keerthy Suresh's emotional performance and Mysskin's high-energy role. Many enjoyed the unpredictable twists, the interval block, and a strong final act, though some felt the initial pacing was slow and the plot predictable. While the background score received some praise, other viewers noted logic flaws and felt the songs could have been better.

shankarabharana.text: Audiences generally praised the film as a well-written horror-comedy blend featuring a strong lead performance by Shine Shetty and effective direction by Sumanth Bhat. Many enjoyed the emotional storytelling and the atmospheric background music by Charan Raj, though some viewers found the second half lacking and noted continuity errors regarding the time period. A few reports mentioned technical issues with dialogue audio in certain theaters.

sidhu.text: There is significant praise for the music, with particular appreciation for the songs' vibe and the vocal performance of Sidhu. Some viewers expressed a preference for other content or artists when comparing the work to others.

signal-at-11-30.text: Audiences generally praised the psychological thriller's intriguing plot and Santhosh Prathap's performance, while highlighting D. Imman's soulful music and background score. The story, inspired by real-life incidents on Chennai's OMR stretch, was noted for its emotional depth and unexpected twists. A chasing scene involving the heroine stood out as a particularly unexpected moment.

ugly-story.text: Audiences are praising the film for its brutal realism, specifically highlighting Nandu's career-best performance and Avika Gor's powerful presence. The psychological story and the chilling background music are noted as strong points. Some viewers mention that the film is not perfect, though it remains emotionally impactful.

valluvan.text: Audiences have reacted positively to Valluvan, praising its strong social message, suspense, and action. Viewers highlighted the captivating music and heartfelt lyrics, as well as the performances of Chethan Cheenu and Ashna Zaveri.
